changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A draft practice exists to be tried: no event, schedule, scan or request selects it (ADR 0118 decision 7).
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE practice ADD CONSTRAINT ck_practice_state CHECK (state IN ('ACTIVE','DRAFT'));

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A version saved to be tried beside a practice in use never becomes current, and history views leave it out (ADR 0118 decision 7).

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM review WHERE origin='TRIAL' AND id IN (SELECT q.review_id FROM review_practice q JOIN practice_version v ON v.id=q.practice_version_id AND v.workspace_id=q.workspace_id WHERE v.tried); DELETE FROM practice_version WHERE tried;
